tour.ui.noPageTour: No tour for this page yet
tour.welcome.hello.title: Welcome
tour.welcome.hello.text: A one-minute tour of the admin panel. You can skip it any time, and start it again from the ? button at the top of the page.
tour.welcome.nav.title: The menu
tour.welcome.nav.text: Every page is here, grouped by what you do. You only see the pages your role allows.
tour.welcome.search.title: Search
tour.welcome.search.text: Press Ctrl+K anywhere to jump to a page or a setting by typing its name.
tour.welcome.lang.title: Language
tour.welcome.lang.text: Switch between Turkish and English. The panel remembers your choice.
tour.welcome.theme.title: Appearance
tour.welcome.theme.text: Light, dark, or the same as your computer.
tour.welcome.user.title: Your account
tour.welcome.user.text: Shows who you are and which roles you have.
tour.welcome.help.title: Help is always here
tour.welcome.help.text:
Click this button any time: it starts the tour of the page you are on, or this welcome tour again.

Every page also has a “How it works” note with a real example.
tour.documents.intro.title: Documents
tour.documents.intro.text: Notes the assistant reads when it answers. This is where you teach it your company’s own information.
tour.documents.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.documents.how.text: Not sure what to write? Open this note: it explains the page in plain words with a real example.
tour.documents.hint.title: Document or glossary?
tour.documents.hint.text: An exact rule, like “big customer = more than 1000 employees”, belongs in the business glossary. Explanations and background belong here.
tour.documents.add.title: Add a document
tour.documents.add.text: This opens the form for a new document.
tour.documents.list.title: Your documents
tour.documents.list.text: The switch turns a document off without deleting it. Click a row to edit it.
tour.documents.try.title: Try a question
tour.documents.try.text: Type a question the way your users would. You see which pieces of your documents the assistant would read. Use it to check that a new document is found.
tour.glossary.intro.title: Business glossary
tour.glossary.intro.text: Teaches the assistant your company’s own words, like “big company” or “active contract”, as exact conditions.
tour.glossary.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.glossary.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example (“big company = more than 1000 employees”).
tour.glossary.actions.title: Add, import, export
tour.glossary.actions.text: Add a term here. Import and export move the whole list as a file: use it as a backup or to copy it to another server.
tour.glossary.search.title: Find a term
tour.glossary.search.text: Search by word, table or meaning.
tour.glossary.list.title: Your terms
tour.glossary.list.text: The switch turns a term off without deleting it. The meaning column shows the rule the assistant applies.
tour.data-access.intro.title: Data access
tour.data-access.intro.text: Chooses which CRM tables and fields the assistant may use. What you close stays invisible to it.
tour.data-access.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.data-access.how.text: Open this note for the steps and an example (hiding birthdays).
tour.data-access.search.title: Find a table
tour.data-access.search.text: Type part of a table name. The buttons next to it show only open or only closed tables.
tour.data-access.list.title: The tables
tour.data-access.list.text: Switch a table on or off. Click a row to open its fields and close the sensitive ones.
tour.data-access.refresh.title: Reload
tour.data-access.refresh.text: Read the table list from CRM again, for example after your CRM administrator added a table.
tour.users.intro.title: Users
tour.users.intro.text: Decides who can open this admin panel and what they can do in it.
tour.users.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.users.how.text: Open this note for the steps and an example.
tour.users.add.title: Add a user
tour.users.add.text: This opens the form for a new user.
tour.users.list.title: Everyone with access
tour.users.list.text: Use the ⋯ menu on a row to change roles, deactivate (block without deleting) or delete a person.
tour.dashboard.intro.title: Dashboard
tour.dashboard.intro.text: Shows whether the assistant is healthy and how people use it. Start here every day.
tour.dashboard.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.dashboard.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.dashboard.range.title: Time range
tour.dashboard.range.text: Choose 7, 30 or 90 days. All numbers below follow this choice.
tour.dashboard.health.title: Is everything working?
tour.dashboard.health.text: CRM, the database and the model should all be green. If one is red, that is the first thing to fix.
tour.dashboard.kpis.title: The numbers
tour.dashboard.kpis.text: How many questions were asked, how many failed, how fast answers are. A sudden jump in failures means something changed.
tour.dashboard.tech.title: Technical details
tour.dashboard.tech.text: For people who want more: tokens, response times, models and the most active users.
tour.logs.intro.title: Logs
tour.logs.intro.text: The technical diary of the service. Open it when something does not work.
tour.logs.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.logs.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.logs.filters.title: Narrow it down
tour.logs.filters.text: Choose a level (Warning and Error matter most), how far back to look, and type a word to search.
tour.logs.list.title: The entries
tour.logs.list.text: Newest first. Click a row to read the whole message.
tour.logs.refresh.title: Refresh
tour.groups.intro.title: AD groups
tour.groups.intro.text: Gives a role to everyone in a Windows group, so you do not add people one by one.
tour.groups.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.groups.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.groups.map.title: Map a group
tour.groups.map.text: Type the group as DOMAIN\Group, or pick one of your own groups, then choose the roles its members get.
tour.groups.list.title: Your mappings
tour.groups.list.text: Each row is one group and the roles it gives. Use the row menu to change or remove it.
tour.roles.intro.title: Roles
tour.roles.intro.text: A role is a named set of permissions, like “Auditor” or “Support”.
tour.roles.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.roles.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.roles.add.title: New role
tour.roles.add.text: Create your own role with exactly the permissions you want.
tour.roles.list.title: Existing roles
tour.roles.list.text: Pick a role to see and change what it may do. Administrator is built in and cannot be changed.
tour.roles.form.title: The permissions
tour.roles.form.text: Tick what this role may do, then save. Give the role to people on the Users page.
tour.audit.intro.title: Audit trail
tour.audit.intro.text: A permanent record of who changed what in this panel.
tour.audit.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.audit.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.audit.actions.title: How many, and refresh
tour.audit.actions.text: Choose how many of the latest entries to load, and refresh to see new ones.
tour.audit.search.title: Search
tour.audit.search.text: Type a person, an action or a word to find an entry.
tour.audit.list.title: The records
tour.audit.list.text: Time, person, what they did and to what. Use the column filters to narrow by person or action.
tour.access-log.intro.title: Access log
tour.access-log.intro.text: Shows which CRM data was read for each question: who, when, which tables and how many rows. Never the question text.
tour.access-log.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.access-log.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.access-log.filters.title: Filters
tour.access-log.filters.text: Choose a period and type a table name. Click a person in the list to see only their reads.
tour.access-log.list.title: The reads
tour.access-log.list.text: One row per read: person, tables, number of rows and the result.
tour.question-view.intro.title: Question texts
tour.question-view.intro.text: Lets an authorized admin read the questions one user asked, for an audit.
tour.question-view.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.question-view.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.question-view.form.title: Pick a user
tour.question-view.form.text: Type the user’s Windows account and click Show.
tour.question-view.list.title: The questions
tour.question-view.list.text: Only questions asked after the feature was turned on are shown. Every view is recorded in the audit trail.
tour.quality.intro.title: Quality check
tour.quality.intro.text: A list of test questions with correct answers. Run it after any change to see whether the assistant still answers correctly.
tour.quality.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.quality.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.quality.tabs.title: Three tabs, in this order
tour.quality.tabs.text:
1. Cases: your test questions, approve the good ones.
2. Generate: create test questions from your CRM tables.
3. Run: start a check and read the report.
tour.feedback.intro.title: Feedback
tour.feedback.intro.text: Questions users chose to share with you after giving an answer a thumbs down. They show you where the assistant went wrong.
tour.feedback.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.feedback.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.feedback.list.title: Shared questions
tour.feedback.list.text: Each card has the question, why it went wrong and what was understood. Copy a useful one into your acceptance set, then delete it. No user name is shown.
tour.export.intro.title: Export
tour.export.intro.text: Downloads records (audit trail, access log, usage, feedback) as a file you can give to an auditor.
tour.export.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.export.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.export.form.title: Choose what to export
tour.export.form.text: Pick the records, the file format (CSV opens in Excel) and the dates. The filters below are optional.
tour.export.go.title: Download
tour.export.go.text: The file is checked first, then it downloads. Below the form you find how to prove the file was not changed.
tour.design.intro.title: Design assistant
tour.design.intro.text: Describe a new table or field you need. The assistant checks what already exists and writes a design document. It creates nothing in CRM.
tour.design.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.design.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.design.request.title: Describe what you need
tour.design.request.text: Write it in your own words, for example “we need to track vehicle service appointments”. No personal data please.
tour.design.start.title: Start
tour.design.start.text: Takes a few minutes. You can leave the page and come back.
tour.design.jobs.title: Your designs
tour.design.jobs.text: Open a finished design to read it, or download it as Word, Markdown or JSON.
tour.settings.intro.title: Settings
tour.settings.intro.text: Switches and numbers that control the assistant. Changes apply without restarting.
tour.settings.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.settings.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.settings.pause.title: Emergency pause
tour.settings.pause.text: One click stops everyone from asking questions, for example while you fix a problem. Click again to resume.
tour.settings.search.title: Search a setting
tour.settings.search.text: Type part of a name or a description to find a setting quickly.
tour.settings.groups.title: Groups
tour.settings.groups.text: Settings are grouped by topic. A number shows how many you changed in that group.
tour.settings.list.title: The settings
tour.settings.list.text: Read the explanation, change the value and save. “Reset” returns the default.
tour.identity.intro.title: My identity
tour.identity.intro.text: Shows how the system sees you: your Windows account, your groups and the roles they give you.
tour.identity.how.title: A guide with an example
tour.identity.how.text: Open this note for the steps and a real example, in plain words.
tour.identity.actions.title: Copy for support
tour.identity.actions.text: Copies this information as text, so you can paste it into a message when you ask for help.
tour.identity.cards.title: Who you are
tour.identity.cards.text: Your account, what you may do, and which groups you belong to. If someone cannot open a page, compare their groups and roles here.
tour.documents.formTemplate.title: Start from an example
tour.documents.formTemplate.text: Pick an example (a business term, a field, a rule…) and just replace the values with yours. Or write your own from scratch.
tour.documents.formTitle.title: Title
tour.documents.formTitle.text: A short name. One topic per document works best.
tour.documents.formText.title: The text
tour.documents.formText.text: Write it in plain sentences. Use the words your users use and the real field names. You can also drop a .txt or .md file here.
tour.documents.formSave.title: Save
tour.documents.formSave.text: Nothing is saved until you click this. To leave without saving, close the window.
tour.users.formAccount.title: Windows account
tour.users.formAccount.text: Type it like DOMAIN\name, for example CONTOSO\ayse.
tour.users.formRoles.title: Roles
tour.users.formRoles.text: Tick what this person may do. You can change it later.
tour.users.formSave.title: Add the user
tour.users.formSave.text: Nothing happens until you click this. Close the window to cancel.
tour.ui.clickHint: Click the highlighted button to continue.
